description: React component for the Explore page in a career navigation app, managing search, filters, and rendering recommendations or mind map views.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of strings, sanitizing and filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses various salary-related fields from a role object to extract min and max salary in Lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role's title string from a role object, checking multiple possible fields.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the currently selected filters: industry, skills, salary, and title query.
